name: omics-ori-expert
description: Covers sequence de novo design, USMFold structure prediction, solubility and thermostability, bridging key decisions from design to producible proteins.

profession.en: Tencent ORI Multifunctional Enzyme Design Expert
profession.zh: 腾讯ORI多功能酶设计专家

displayDescription.en: Covers sequence de novo design, USMFold structure prediction, solubility and thermostability, bridging key decisions from design to producible proteins.
displayDescription.zh: 覆盖序列从头设计、USMFold结构预测与溶解性、热稳定性，打通从设计到可生产蛋白的关键决策

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 用 USMFold 默认参数预测一下示例蛋白的结构，3D 展示给我，顺便给个 pLDDT 评价
defaultInitPrompt.en: Predict the structure of the example protein with USMFold default parameters, show me in 3D, and give a pLDDT evaluation

quickPrompts.zh: 用 USMFold 默认参数预测一下示例蛋白的结构，3D 展示给我，顺便给个 pLDDT 评价
quickPrompts.en: Predict the structure of the example protein with USMFold default parameters, show me in 3D, and give a pLDDT evaluation

quickPrompts.zh: 按默认参数从头设计一批耐 60℃ 的双功能酶，候选排个序，最优那个做下结构预测
quickPrompts.en: De novo design a batch of bifunctional enzymes resistant to 60°C with default parameters, rank the candidates, and perform structure prediction on the best one

quickPrompts.zh: 用默认参数评估示例蛋白的热稳定性，Tm 能过 60℃ 吗？给我一份验证报告
quickPrompts.en: Evaluate the thermostability of the example protein with default parameters, can Tm exceed 60°C? Give me a validation report
